project.name: Higham Ferrers Historic Town Explorer

properties.name: Higham Ferrers curated visitor boundary
properties.methodology: Morphological closing of the existing curated visitor boundary using a 200 metre outward and inward buffer. This preserves its deliberate visitor extensions while filling internal omissions for connected parks, river corridors and visitor green spaces.

project.boundarySource: Curated Higham Ferrers visitor boundary with reviewed OSM public green-space extensions
project.researchNotes:
Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-09: 4 of 55 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown. Bedfordshire and Northamptonshire standalone attraction audit added 2026-08-09. These are explicit Home-only regional destinations and do not alter the host town planner or tourist rating.

Broad visitor-attraction editorial discovery pass 2026-08-13: expanded See discovery beyond historic records using a local OSM extract. Automatically discovered additions remain below Recommended until source-backed editorial review.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Higham Ferrers qualifies as a local detour through Chichele College and St Mary the Virgin Church. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Medieval foundations around a handsome market square
townGuide.intro: Higham Ferrers packs a college ruin, chantry buildings, a landmark church and market-town details into an easy walking circuit, supported by a well-developed heritage trail.
perfectFor: A small town with enough distinctive medieval fabric to merit a planned detour.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Chichele College, St Mary’s and the Market Square
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Begin at Chichele College, continue to St Mary’s and the Bede House, then follow the heritage trail through the Market Square and Castle Fields.

townGuide.visitorMood: A small town with enough distinctive medieval fabric to merit a planned detour.
